factProposals.value: Whether PostgreSQL, the API and WhatsApp Business are connected cannot be determined from the repo; the Command Center shows them as not checked until the running system reports its own health.
The plan carries no outcome measures or numeric targets yet (plan.derived.measures is empty).
The plan carries no scoped AI agents; stories are owned by roles via owner_agent.
progress.json totals report 800 points awarded while 0 stories are verified; unclear whether this is points available or earned.
A proposed 14-table data model: every business table carries tenant_id and money is stored as integer kobo. Not created yet.

decisions.statement: The Command Center is a static page that reads .colaberry/plan.json, progress.json and manifest.json at runtime, with no backend or API key.
decisions.rationale: A static page cannot keep a secret, and the platform rewrites these files on every sync.

decisions.statement: When index.html is opened from disk, the page asks the user to pick the three .colaberry files and reads them directly; scripts are classic rather than ES modules.
decisions.rationale: Browsers block file:// pages from fetching neighbouring files and from running module scripts.

decisions.statement: Connection indicators default to grey 'not checked from here', never green.
decisions.rationale: plan.json only names the systems; nothing in the repo can reach them.

limitations.statement: Opened from disk, the data files must be selected again after every reload.
The Knowledge base chat is keyword-based over plan.json and progress.json, not an AI model; it declines questions the files cannot answer.
